title: Bass conjecture
exact_target: Are all higher coherent-module K-theory groups of rings of finite type over the integers finitely generated? The equivalent regular-ring version uses projective-module K-theory.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200002 (AMR-071-0002). CC BY 4.0.
Thomas Geisser, Finite generation conjectures for cohomology over finite fields (2011). Introduction, p. 1.
